Gumroad 和 AppSumo 可抓，Algora API 重定向。先修 Algora API，同时看后台任务。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
 "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/json'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "(async function(){",
 " // algora 正确 API",
 " const cands=[",
 " 'https://algora.io/api/bounties?limit=20',",
 " 'https://algora.io/api/v1/bounties',",
 " 'https://algora.io/api/public/bounties'",
 " ];",
 " for(const u of cands){",
 " try{",
 " const r=await get(u);",
 " console.log('=== '+u+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length);",
 " console.log(r.body.substring(0,400).replace(/\\s+/g,' '));",
 " }catch(e){ console.log(u+' ERR '+e.message); }",
 " await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,4000)});",
 " }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-al.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-al.cjs";
const [r, job] = await Promise.all([
 tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Find working Algora API endpoint", timeoutMs: 200000 }),
 tools.job_output({ job_id: "pwsh-196" }),
]);
console.log("### ALGORA\n" + (r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 4000) : ""));
console.log("\n### JOB PROGRESS\n" + (job.text ?? "").slice(-1500));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
  "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/json'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "(async function(){",
  "  // algora 正确 API",
  "  const cands=[",
  "    'https://algora.io/api/bounties?limit=20',",
  "    'https://algora.io/api/v1/bounties',",
  "    'https://algora.io/api/public/bounties'",
  "  ];",
  "  for(const u of cands){",
  "    try{",
  "      const r=await get(u);",
  "      console.log('=== '+u+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length);",
  "      console.log(r.body.substring(0,400).replace(/\\s+/g,' '));",
  "    }catch(e){ console.log(u+' ERR '+e.message); }",
  "    await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,4000)});",
  "  }",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-al.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-al.cjs";
const [r, job] = await Promise.all([
  tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Find working Algora API endpoint", timeoutMs: 200000 }),
  tools.job_output({ job_id: "pwsh-196" }),
]);
console.log("### ALGORA\n" + (r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 4000) : ""));
console.log("\n### JOB PROGRESS\n" + (job.text ?? "").slice(-1500));
